verdict.rationale: Granola documents connecting Google Calendar or Outlook to see upcoming meetings and create notes from events, and calendar-linked notifications open the call and start transcribing when clicked. Nothing shows automatic capture driven by configurable per-meeting-type rules. Per-call-type templates control note formatting, not which meetings get captured, so they earn no credit here. Missing for 10: per-meeting-type auto-capture rules, any documented automatic recording without user action, independent corroboration of the calendar workflow.
